purpose: Per-character supplementary overview images for human-facing visual concept recall and bounded character-design/research tasks. These images are outside the six-sheet production reference packs.

policy.rule: Do not use these sources as face, body, production-consistency, wardrobe, expression, accepted-character-continuity, or renderer attachments. Any embedded names, ages, heights, jobs, biography, quotes, outfit labels, or other text are non-authoritative.
